description:
In this video, we discuss how China controls the internet within its borders through the famous Great Firewall. This system blocks many foreign websites and limits what Chinese citizens can see online, making it difficult for the outside world to know what is really happening inside China.

We also explore how China built and maintains this massive censorship network. The video looks at allegations that Chinese-linked groups and online networks have been involved in spreading misinformation and propaganda targeting India.

For years, China has projected an image of having no major corruption, crime, or social problems. However, many Indians are now challenging these claims and sharing information that presents a different picture. As more people question the narrative, cracks are beginning to appear in China's information wall.

There is a vast difference between robustly defending our national image and stooping to copy the exact authoritarian, state-controlled information tactics of an adversary.

Why should India compromise its democratic framework or misallocate its hard-earned capital on Par Charcha (gossip and trolling)? Our nation is at a crucial juncture where every single rupee must be funneled into fulfilling genuine domestic needs—improving public infrastructure, investing in technological innovation, upgrading healthcare, and strengthening our defense hardware.

China did not achieve its economic footprint because of its state-backed digital trolls (the Wumao); it did so by building an economic powerhouse.
